summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade (the research and seminar courses are offered only S/NC and still count), toward 45 graduate units. The audit checks six units from the listed graduate chemistry courses, six more units of graduate-level lecture courses, CHEM 200 research and your division's seminar. You check by hand the MS thesis, about two-thirds of the units in Chemistry, and the program proposal approved by the end of your first graduate quarter.

The 45 units are the Bulletin's program minimum, which the audit checks, and the lecture units are x2oub4Gg and ov-lecture; the course-transfer rules are information.
